title: Rectangle that validates
prompt: Implement nested class `Solution.Rectangle`: constructor `(double width, double height)` throws `ArgumentException` unless both are positive; read-only `Width`/`Height`; `Area()`; `Scale(double factor)` grows **both** dimensions and throws `ArgumentException` for a non-positive factor.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Scale multiplies every dimension, so area grows by factor squared.

tests.name: validation
tests.hint: Invalid construction must throw at the constructor — never store bad state.
